title: Event
description: One line of .design/telemetry/events.jsonl — the append-only telemetry stream produced by Plan 20-06. Each event is a single JSON object followed by a newline. See .planning/phases/20-gdd-sdk-foundation/20-06-PLAN.md.

type.description: Free-form event type identifier. Pre-registered seeds: state.mutation, state.transition, stage.entered, stage.exited, hook.fired, error, capability_gap, kfm-candidate, router_pick, verify_outcome, rollout_started, rollout_advanced, rollout_stuck, budget_forecast, project_cap_warning, project_cap_halt.

sessionId.description: Stable identifier per GDD pipeline run; correlates events across stages.

stage.description: Optional — present when the event is scoped to a pipeline stage.

cycle.description: Optional — present when the event is scoped to a cycle identifier.

payload.description: Event-type-specific payload. Opaque at the envelope level. When type === 'capability_gap', the payload is narrowed by the conditional schema in allOf[0] to the 7-field CapabilityGapPayload (Phase 29 D-02).

_meta.description: Writer-injected provenance. Never set by callers.

_truncated.description: Writer-set flag indicating the payload exceeded maxLineBytes and has been replaced by a placeholder.

trajectory_path.description: Repo-relative or absolute path to the trajectory-JSONL file containing the referenced evidence slice.

byte_start.description: Inclusive byte offset into the trajectory file marking the start of the evidence slice.

byte_end.description: Exclusive byte offset into the trajectory file marking the end of the evidence slice.

content_hash.description: Hash-pinned content fingerprint (Phase 29 D-07). Detects retroactive chain mutation.

TrajectoryRef.description: Pointer to a slice of a trajectory-JSONL file (Phase 29 D-07). Hash-pinned so consumers can detect chain mutation. Used inside CapabilityGapPayload.evidence_refs to keep payloads small while preserving audit-traceability — pointers, NOT duplicated trajectory content.

event_id.description: UUIDv4 identifying this capability_gap event. Stable across emit + read cycles.

parent_event_id.description: UUIDv4 of the parent chain event when the gap was surfaced inside a larger trajectory; null when this is a root emit (e.g. /gdd:fast bail-out).

source.description: Which surface detected the gap. fast = /gdd:fast no-skill-match path; router = gdd-router unmatched-intent path; reflector_pattern = reflector pattern-detection pass (Plan 29-02).

context_hash.description: Stable hash of the intent/context that surfaced the gap. Used by 29-03 aggregation to cluster recurring gaps with the same hash.

intent_summary.description: Short human-readable description of the failed lookup. Capped at 256 chars per D-02 — keeps payload small + auditable.

suggested_kind.description: Drafter hint for 29-04 incubator-author. fast emits 'skill' (narrow primitive); router emits 'agent' (multi-step workflow); reflector_pattern may emit either.

evidence_refs.description: Pointers to trajectory-JSONL slices that evidence the gap (D-07). Hash-pinned to detect chain mutation. Empty array allowed for low-evidence emits (e.g. /gdd:fast which has no trajectory).

CapabilityGapPayload.description: Phase 29 D-02 capability_gap payload — exactly 7 fields, additionalProperties: false. Validated when the envelope's type === 'capability_gap' via the allOf[0] conditional.

event_id.description: Stable identifier for this kfm-candidate event. Used by Plan 30.5-03 reflector to de-dupe re-emissions of the same authority-watcher article hit.

source.description: Phase 30.5-03 D-06 — the kfm-candidate event class is emitted EXCLUSIVELY by the authority-watcher pipeline. No other producer is authorised.

article_url.description: Permalink to the source article. Logged into the incubator draft body so the user can audit provenance.

article_title.description: Article title verbatim — feeds the symptom-derivation heuristic + the draft origin header.

suggested_symptom.description: Reflector-consumed symptom string. Derived from the article H1/H2 + title; capped to a single line.

suggested_pattern_hint.description: Best-effort regex fragment proposed by the watcher heuristic. Empty string when the watcher cannot infer a pattern; the user fills `pattern` via the apply-reflections edit action.

raw_excerpt.description: Up-to-500-char excerpt of the article body. Truncated with an ellipsis if longer. Hard cap is enforced by the schema; the watcher truncates before emission.

KfmCandidatePayload.description: Phase 30.5-03 D-06 kfm-candidate payload — 7 fields, additionalProperties: false. Validated when the envelope's type === 'kfm-candidate' via the allOf[1] conditional.

event_id.description: UUIDv4 identifying this router_pick event. Stable across emit + read cycles.

source.description: Phase 32-08 D-02 — the router_pick event class is emitted EXCLUSIVELY by the gdd-router skill at its resolved-pick point. No other producer is authorised.

picked_skill.description: The skill or agent the router auto-picked for this intent. Phase 33 baselines per-skill auto-pick rates from this field (pick-rate regression).

context_hash.description: sha256 of the intent/context that drove the pick — NEVER the raw prompt (no PII, mirrors CapabilityGapPayload.context_hash discipline). Used by Phase 33 aggregation to cluster picks for the same context.

rank.description: Rank of the picked_skill among the candidates considered (0 = top pick). Lets Phase 33 distinguish confident top picks from close calls.

alternatives.description: Other candidate skill/agent names the router considered (names only — no scores, no prompt text). May be empty when the router had a single match. Surfaces which skills the router weighs but does not reach for.

ts.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the pick emission.

RouterPickPayload.description: Phase 32-08 D-02 router_pick payload — 7 fields, additionalProperties: false, NO PII (context_hash only). Records which skill the router auto-picked per intent — the instrument that surfaces under-reached skills. Validated when the envelope's type === 'router_pick' via the allOf[2] conditional.
